items.title: A collection of open sets closed under finite intersections and containing the members of an open cover is a basis
items.author: The Stacks Project Authors
items.source_version: Stacks Project git a04446e57ec1 (2026-07-28); file topology.tex; corpus local snapshot 20261012
items.difficulty_reason: The counted statement gives a sufficient condition for a collection of open sets to be a basis: it must contain the members of an open cover up to the basis property and be closed under finite intersections (author lemma at source lines 514-522, label lemma-make-base). The proof (source lines 524-549) verifies the defining property of a basis by choosing a covering member and then a collection member inside the relevant intersection (proof lines 524-548). The pointwise construction is the content. H3.
